exemption application. The prayer made 
in the exemption application (IA/1/2026)
is that requirement of filing affidavit in 
support of averments made in the writ 
petition may be dispensed with. 
(3) This Court is not inclined to 
grant the prayer made by the petitioner. 
Filing of affidavit in support of averments 
made in the writ petition is mandatory. If 
petitioner has difficulty in visiting Nainital 
for swearing the affidavit, then affidavit 
can be sworn by her in the district where 
she is residing. The prayer for exemption 
is, accordingly, rejected. 
(4) Let affidavit in support of 
averments made in the writ petition be 
filed within two weeks. 
(5) List on 16.4.2026 under the 
same caption.

Janki Sah
--Petitioner
 Versus
State Of Uttarakhand
--Respondent
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Sandeep Adhikari, learned Legal Aid Counsel 
for the petitioner.
2. Mr. K.N. Joshi, learned Dy.A.G. for the State.
3. In view of the grounds stated, Delay Condonation 
Application (IA/2/2026) is disposed of. Counter 
affidavit filed by respondent nos.2 and 3 is taken on 
record. 
4. Petitioner was engaged on contract through 
UPNL as lady Bandi Rakshak in District Jail, Almora. 
5. The services of petitioner were disengaged by 
respondents for the reason that petitioner herself had 
refused to serve as Bandi Rakshak due to which 
another lady was called from Home guards who 
discharged the duties of lady Bandi Rakshak and now 
the situation is that the said post has already been 
filled up by way of regular selection.
5. It is contended by learned State Counsel that at 
present, there is no vacancy on the post of lady Bandi 
Rakshak in District Jail Almora.
6. Learned Counsel for the petitioner contends that 
petitioner is a single mother who has the burden of 
raising a child, and therefore, she may be 
accommodated in any other nearby place like Nainital 
and Haldwani. 
7. Learned State Counsel is directed to seek clear  instructions by next week as to whether there exists 
any vacancy of lady Bandi Rakshak in District Jail, 
Nainital or Sub-Jail Haldwani where petitioner can be 
accommodated.
8. List on 14.07.2026.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 07.07.2026 R.Dang

--Petitioner
 Versus
State Of Uttarakhand
--Respondent
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Sandeep Adhikari, learned Legal-Aid￾Counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. K.N. Joshi, learned Dy.A.G. for the State.
3. Delay condonation application (IA/2/2026) is 
allowed. Delay is condoned. Counter affidavit filed by 
respondent nos.2 and 3 is accepted on record.
4. Vide previous order dated 07.07.2026, the State 
Counsel was directed by the Court to find out as to 
whether there exists any vacancy of lady Bandi 
Rakshak in District Jail, Nainital or Sub-Jail, 
Haldwani. 
5. Today, learned State Counsel has supplied the 
instructions dated 11.07.2026 to the Court. The same 
are taken on record. On the strength of those 
instructions, learned State Counsel submits that there 
are two vacancies of lady Bandi Rakshak each in 
District Jail, Nainital and Sub-Jail, Haldwani. For 
filling up those posts, requisition is yet to be sent.
6. Keeping in view the fact that the petitioner is a 
single mother and she has already worked in District 
Jail, Almora as lady Bandi Rakshak, petitioner can 
well be accommodated against any of the vacant 
posts, as stated above. 7. List on 27.07.2026. On that day, learned State 
Counsel is directed to make a clear statement before 
the Court that at which place, petitioner can be 
accommodated till a regularly selected incumbent 
joins the post of lady Bandi Rakshak.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 14.07.2026 R.Dang
